title: Pure API-swap refactor with no new/changed test. The makePollWidthClearer facto…
description:
Pure API-swap refactor with no new/changed test. The makePollWidthClearer factory contract is fully covered by existing unit tests and is untouched, and ink-testing-library cannot vary columns between ticks (documented in patterns.md), so a component-level SIGWINCH width-change regression is infeasible with the current harness. A future story could add a real ink render() with a hand-built mutable-columns stdout to assert the dep-array freshness end-to-end. Non-blocking.
